channel.description: Today's vulnerability curation reveals a critical threat landscape characterized by widespread remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws that severely compromise enterprise infrastructure, with Microsoft ecosystems representing the primary source of risk. Hundreds of critical flaws target core networking services such as Windows DNS and DHCP, cloud platforms including Azure and SQL Server, and developer tools, utilizing techniques like buffer overflows, authentication bypasses, and command injection to facilitate lateral movement and unauthorized system access. Beyond traditional IT environments, significant weaknesses persist in mobile applications, industrial control systems, and IoT devices, exposing operational technology and collaboration endpoints to exploitation via document delivery, network spoofing, and configuration manipulation.
